name: Tesseract OCR
description: A photo or a page in, the words out, entirely on this device. Unofficial port of Tesseract.js: the Tesseract OCR engine compiled to WebAssembly, reading English. The engine rides inside this GIF; English downloads the first time you read a page (~15 MB, hash-pinned) and then stays on the computer. Nothing is uploaded — there is no network path out of this browser. Not a table tool: for tables in a PDF see Scanned PDF Tables → Excel.
